contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Parse typed decimal text by dropping all ECMAScript whitespace and accepting a first decimal comma only when no dot exists. Accept only signed plain decimal, not exponents or suffixes. Use fallback on failure, then multiply the selected number by factor. Fallback is not the final unscaled result.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Text has at most 20 characters, any accepted value is finite and between -1000 and 1000, and numeric arguments are between -1000 and 1000.

inputRoles.fallback: number substituted on parse failure before scaling

contract.outputRole: parsed or fallback number multiplied by factor
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
